push.title: L 1-2 vs Dagestan SC | You: 9.3 (2nd best match performance)
push.body:
Your 2nd best match performance, buddskees. A 9.3 against Dagestan SC, and you looked like you belonged.

THE GOOD
+ 31 passes, your busiest match yet. Every attack seemed to have your fingerprints on it.
+ Won 3 of 4 tackles. Clean win, no foul, ball's ours. Beautiful.
+ A goal against Dagestan SC. That's a finish they'll replay at the club banquet.
+ Man of the Match, your 3rd for us. Everybody wants to play with someone who plays like that.
+ Man of the Match in a losing side: the bright spot on a dark night. More of that, please and thank you.

THE BAD
- Giveaways 8, up from your usual 4. That's where the match slipped.
- Lowest shots on the team: 1 (best was BellyTb1's 2). Real talk: Attack the box. Near post and far post on every cross and every cutback.
- Tackles attempted: 4. Halfway to the summit; the peak is 6+.
- Key passes: 1. Halfway up the mountain. The view from 2+ is something else.
- A one-goal loss (1-2): a single moment decided it. That's the bill for the little mistakes, and we all chipped in.

Rondo time: When the lane closes, switch the point of attack instead of threading the needle.

Remember, buddskees: If it was easy, everybody'd be in Division 1.

Proud of you, partner. - Coach Lasso

push.title: L 1-2 vs Dagestan SC | You: 6.5 (6th worst match performance)
push.body:
BellyTb1, a 6.5, your 6th worst match performance. I believe in you as much as I did this morning.

THE GOOD
+ Shot accuracy 100%, up from your usual 63%. More of that, please and thank you.
+ Fewest missed tackles on the team (0). That's growth you can count.
+ Passes attempted 24, from 17 in your previous match. That's the stuff I want framed.

THE BAD
- No tackles attempted. Real quick: Get stuck in. A won tackle is worth about 0.2 rating, and even 1 in 8 pays for the attempts. Small fix, big smile.
- 0 goals from 2 on target. Tell you what: We're hitting the target, so now aim for the corners. Keepers love a shot down the middle.
- Your 6th worst match performance (6.5). We'll get you back up the list.
- You and PhogsToffees, same lesson: forcing passes. Same answer: give each other short options.
- Lowest key passes on the team: 0 (best was buddskees's 1). Let's call that a lesson and not a trend.

THE UGLY
! Pass accuracy 54% (13 of 24). I've seen tidier yard sales. Back to basics: If you're pressed from behind, play it back the way you're facing. Don't turn into trouble.

Pre-match routine: Defend the space, not just the player. Stand in the lane they want to pass into.

BellyTb1, you already know this, but I'll say it anyway: Every pro was once an amateur who didn't quit.

We'll sharpen it at practice. - Coach Lasso
